# Biryani Ipsum

> The tastiest placeholder text generator for developers.

## What is this?
Biryani Ipsum is a humorous, open-source alternative to standard Lorem Ipsum (Latin placeholder text). Instead of boring Latin, it generates text using vocabulary related to Indian cuisine, specifically Biryani (e.g., "Dum," "Masala," "Raita," "Leg Piece").

## Who is it for?
- Web Designers needing placeholder text.
- Developers looking for a fun alternative to Lorem Ipsum.
- Food bloggers and Indian startups.

## Key Features
- **Custom Length:** Generate Small (Snack), Medium (Lunch), or Large (Feast) paragraphs.
- **Spicy Mode:** Option to include HTML tags (`<p>`) automatically.
- **One-Click Copy:** Fast clipboard integration.
- **Lightweight:** Built with vanilla JS and Tailwind CSS.

## Usage
Visit https://biryaniipsum.org.in/ to generate text instantly.
